overview.value: When Inori returns to Onegai Town, she makes a wish to the goddess statue in the town square. "Please give me a chance to become an AiPri!" Suddenly, Aoi, a popular AiPri, calls out to her. When they go to the AiPri shop together, Inori is asked by a little girl named Moko to choose a present for her older sister who is moving away. When Inori advises her to "give her something she 'likes' from the bottom of her heart," the stuffed animal Aoi was holding suddenly starts talking! The mysterious stuffed animal, who calls herself Fortune, and Aoi give Inori a Mirror Pact to become an AiPri and a Wish Jewel...

Inori begins her life in Onegai Town. When she enrolls in Onegai Middle School, Aoi is in the same class. After school, Aoi takes Inori to Meganee's cafe in Onegai Town. There, Fortune asks Inori to join the "Wish-Fulfilling Squad," which grants the wishes of the people of Onegai Town. The first person Fortune receives a wish from is Koharu, an upperclassman at the same school. What could Koharu's wish be...?

Inori and Aoi encounter a girl who is searching for something. She is Gumi Tomosaka, a classmate of theirs. She says she has lost a sticker that she cherished. It is a one-of-a-kind sticker that her younger brother and sister gave her for her birthday. Inori and Aoi are asked to help her find it. Inori and Aoi begin searching to fulfill Gumi's wish, but the sticker is nowhere to be found...

Inori and Aoi, on an errand for Meganee-san, arrive as requested. When they enter the Western-style confectionery shop they were looking for, they find Gumi there. Patisserie Tomosaka is Gumi's family business. After watching Inori and Aoi's live performance, Gumi tells them how amazing it is, and Inori asks, "Why don't you try AiPri?" But Gumi shakes her head, saying it's impossible. For the next few days, Gumi leaves school early after classes. In fact, she had been secretly training to become an Aipri without telling Inori and Aoi. Inori wants to see what she's doing...

Inori's grandfather is the mayor of Onegai Town. He prays to the goddess statue, saying, "I want to make this town a place full of smiles so that everyone can be even more cheerful than they are now." Hearing this, Inori gathers many people in the town square and proposes to hold the "Onegai Town AiPri Festival," or "AiPri Fest" for short. Then, on the day of the festival, not many people have gathered in the square. However, with the help of Koharu from the AiPri Club, people gradually begin to gather. Inori, Aoi, and Gumi are pumped up. The festival is about to begin!

Today, it's a sleepover at Aoi's house. Inori and Gumi are excited, but the serious Aoi says she wants to have a debriefing session about the AiPri Festival. The festival was a success, but she wants to be able to perform for even more people. Aoi tells the two of them about her aspirations. As a result of the debriefing, they come up with two goals: "to fill the plaza with customers" and "to try a new type of live performance." After dinner, Aoi's older sister, Wakaba, comes home. Wakaba, who is in the track and field club, is happy because she ran with her friends and set a new record. Hearing this, Gumi says she wants to see Inori and Aoi's live performance...

The Wish-Fulfilling Team received two requests. The first was from Satsuki. She was worried because she had injured herself during club practice, but her friends were saying it was "nothing serious." The other was from Aoi's older sister, Wakaba. She was worried because she wasn't in good form, even though a track and field competition was coming up. Gumi decided to support Satsuki, while Aoi and Inori decided to support Wakaba. The Wish-Fulfilling Team worked hard to fulfill both of their wishes, but...

Inori and the others thank Olivia, the student council president, for helping to make the AiPri Festival a success. However, Olivia seems very busy with the student council's "Flower Planting Campaign." Gumi brings Olivia some baked goods to cheer her up as she works hard alone. Olivia became student council president at someone's request. She's also working hard on the "Flower Planting Campaign" all by herself, thinking of everyone. But deep down, she wishes she could have fun doing it with everyone. When Gumi hears this, she...

Olivia visits the AiPri Shop alone. Seeing how much Olivia knows about AiPri's, Mega-nee asks her, "Do you want to become an Aipri?" Just then, Inori and the Wish-Fulfilling Team, along with Koharu, arrive at the shop. Olivia quickly leaves the shop as if she was running away. Koharu had wanted to talk to Olivia about the next AiPri Festival. Meanwhile, Olivia still worries about lying to Koharu, saying that she didn't know much about AiPris, even though she actually wanted to become one. At that moment, a request arrives from Koharu to Inori and the others: "I want courage..."

Something is wrong with Olivia's younger brother, Leon. Leon is found in the schoolyard with lots of bread. This morning, Olivia's portion of bread was gone. Worried, Olivia begins searching for Leon.

Inori's birthday is fast approaching. Inori invites Aoi and the others to her birthday party. She sets off to find a venue. Aoi, Gumi, and Olivia visit Inori's grandparents to give her a present. As they try to find out what Inori likes, Aoi and the others learn that every time Inori returns to Onegai Town, she prays to the goddess's statue, "May I always be good friends with my best friends." Determined to make it the best birthday party ever for Inori, Aoi and the others are excited. However, on the day of the party, the weather is unfortunately rainy...

Koharu wants Olivia's live performance to be the main event of the upcoming second AiPri Festival. Gumi encourages her to do it, but Olivia firmly refuses, saying she's not confident. Both girls are dejected. Inori and Aoi, who received Koharu's wish that they make up, perform a duo live show! Just as Olivia receives their feelings, her brother Aran appears. After receiving some great advice from him, Olivia runs off to Gumi...

The second annual AiPri Festival is finally about to begin. Even more people have gathered than last time, and Inori is excited and in high spirits. However, Olivia is trembling with nervousness. This is contagious, and Aoi and the others start shivering as well. Just then, Wakaba, Koharu, Satsuki, Leon, Moko, Gam, Choco, and Ho come to cheer them on. Regaining her composure, Olivia goes out onto the stage. Then, the Inori and Aoi duo takes the stage, and the festival becomes a huge success. However, Atami Nana watches the whole scene with a serious expression...

The second AiPri Festival has ended, and the Wish-Fulfilling Squad is full of energy with Aoi as their new leader. Then, a wish arrives from Kanata, a student at High Sense Academy. Kanata says she entered High Sense Academy with the dream of becoming a fashion designer, but has now given up. She had prayed to the statue of the goddess, "May I find my true dream." Just then, Atami Nana, also from High Sense Academy, appears. Nana urges Kanata, "Don't rely on anyone, figure it out on your own." Hearing this, Gumi tries to find Kanata's "true dream"...

From the Atami family mansion, figures can be seen gazing out at Onegai Town... It's Atami Nana, her brother Sango, and their butler, Hyozan. Sango asks, "Nana, if you become an AiPri, do you think you can grant someone's wish?" Nana decides to become an AiPri. At the same time, Shioki and Koike from the Onegai Middle School student council are making a wish to the goddess. They are lamenting that they can't get their hands on a watermelon and won't be able to make everyone happy during their summer off-campus volunteer activity. Inori and Aoi perform a live show to cheer them up. Just as Shioki and Koike regain their motivation, Nana appears before them...

Inori and her friends are looking forward to summer vacation. Nana has performed many live shows, but has yet to successfully perform a Buzzrium Change. Just then, a request arrives. It's from Olivia's younger brother, Leon. Leon is depressed because he has angered his friend Manabu by not getting a perfect score on a test. Gumi performs a live show to help them make up. Nana watches them and tries to achieve a Buzzrium Change with her own passion...

Summer vacation has begun. On her way to Meganee's cafe, Inori hears a rumor from Moko that there's a ghost on the beach. Inori suggests that the Wishing Squad go and look for it. However, Aoi refuses, saying she has summer homework to do. Nana then joins them and asks Aoi, the leader, "What do you want to do with the Wishing Squad from now on?" Aoi is troubled and can't answer immediately. Just then, they spot a ghost on the beach! Or so they think, but it turns out to be a dejected Fumika...

Gamu and Choco want to make the next AiPri Festival a success, so they start building a huge sandcastle on the beach. Just as it's almost finished, they go home to get the flag they'll put on top. When they return to the beach with Gumi, they find the sandcastle has been swallowed by the waves and collapsed. Dejected, Gamu and Choco end up fighting. Inori and Aoi perform a live show to cheer up Choco. Meanwhile, Emma appears before Gamu, who has made a wish: "I hope I can build a sandcastle with Choco again." It turns out that Emma was the one who advised him to make the wish. What exactly is her aim...?

After seeing Nana's passionate live performance, Megane's older sister was filled with emotion and embarked on a three-day summer vacation. During that time, Nana's butler, Hyozan, was put in charge of acting store manager. Inori and the others also decided to help out at the store. Thanks to Nana's publicity, many customers came, and the Wish-Fulfilling Team was full of energy. --And then Shioki arrived. Shioki, along with Ema, ​​belongs to the "Wish Town Mystery Research Society." She had wished to see the "Midsummer Blue Jewel," which is said to be only visible during the summer. Taking her wish to heart, Ema took to the stage for the live performance.

The 3rd AiPri Festival is fast approaching. The day before, Sango's "High-Sense Festival" will be held. It seems to be a variety show featuring talk segments, games, and prize giveaways, with the super-popular talent "Tate Goto" making an appearance. Nana suggests that she perform the final live show of the AiPri Festival to liven up the event. However, Olivia argues that Nana's performance is only worthy of being at the top. The two girls' relationship becomes strained... Nana challenges Olivia to a live show showdown...

The town of Onegai, a seaside town that sparkles and shines in the sunlight. In the town square stands a statue of a goddess, and it is said that if you make a wish to the goddess, that wish will come true. Inori and Aoi met in front of that statue. That was the beginning of the miracles that would unfold in Onegai Town. This special episode looks back on the many events that have occurred since Inori and Aoi met, together with Forchu.

The day of the showdown between the AiPri Festival and the High-Sense Festival has arrived. The High-Sense Festival is buzzing with excitement thanks to Tate Goto's sweet poetry. But then, as if to drown out the excitement, Nana appears, instantly raising the energy of the AiPri Festival. Then, Inori and Aoi appear. Their duo performance sends the audience into a frenzy. This is followed by Emma's solo, and then a duet by Aoi and Gumi. The AiPri Festival and the High-Sense Festival are neck and neck in terms of excitement so far. Which one will win?!

Summer vacation is over and second semester begins. Nana came to Onegai Junior High School where Inori and her friends were.. Nana asks her to find Emma, ​​who is also a student at the Hisense Academy she attends.. When I looked into it, it appears that he has submitted a transfer notification.. Nana forms the Onegai Detective Team with Inori and Aoi to investigate Emma's whereabouts.. During Gumi and Oribia duo live, Nana and her friends discover Emma carrying a large bag.. Emma said, "Please, I have to leave town.".

Inori's friend, Mai-chan, has come to Onegai Town. Inori gives her a tour of Onegai Town. Mai-chan, a huge fan of AiPri, is thrilled to meet Inori, Olivia, Gumi, Emma, ​​Nana, and Aoi. She is also very happy to see Nana and Emma perform live. Another thing she wanted to do in Onegai Town was to meet her pen pal, Ayaka-chan. Inori and the others begin searching for her together. However, they discover that the picture book store where Ayaka was supposed to live moved a week ago...

Rumors spread that a girl ghost haunts AiPriverse. Emma, ​​a member of the "Mystery Research Club," is fascinated by ghosts. Just then, a request arrives from AiPriverse. Inori and the others immediately head to I-Priverse. There, they meet the three members of the AiPri Club: Riori, Azumin, and Kyoka. Riori and the others say that the request was made by a ghost. Just then, the rumored girl appears before the Wish Granting Team!? And what is the ghost's request...?

Inori prays to the statue of the goddess, "Please let me meet the goddess soon." To make the "miracle of the goddess" happen, they must start walking towards a new dream. To do that, Inori and the others realize they need to fulfill many more wishes and begin special training. Nana comes up with ideas like taiyaki-themed outfits and poetry, but Gumi objects, saying, "I think something's not right." Their opinions clash, and the two girls fall apart. Left alone, Inori feels anxious. To make matters worse, she receives news that her grandfather has been hospitalized...
To perform a miracle, they must overcome the "Goddess's Trial." The team of three, Inori, Gumi, and Nana, has decided on the name "Smile Heart" and is full of enthusiasm.

Autumn is the season for art. An art festival is being held at the Wish Square, and it's a huge success. Inori, Gumi, and Nana are enjoying themselves. However, Aoi, Olivia, and Emma are anxious to make their trio live performance a success as soon as possible. Emma and the others know their own personalities, that they are too cautious and can't act quickly. They decide to think together about what the three of them need right now. But they can't seem to find an answer. Just then, Aoi and the others receive a request from Shioki and Koike, who are participating in the art festival...

Emma wants to perform the "Goddess's Miracle," but feels she still isn't trying hard enough. Meanwhile, Inori wants to become closer to Emma, ​​who, along with Aoi and the other girl, has deepened their bond and successfully held a Pure Heart live performance. Inori immediately goes to see Emma. Emma is anxious because she needs to collect the Wish Prisms. However, she is moved by Inori's enthusiastic desire to "get to know Emma better!" and the two end up playing together...

Today is Halloween, which everyone has been looking forward to. They receive candy from Megane-nee-san, take pictures together, and have a wonderful time. Gumi and Olivia plan to perform a live show in new outfits for their younger siblings. However, at that moment, an incident occurs at the AiPriverse. Purineko's head and Megane-nee-san's glasses turn into pumpkins. Purineko says it's a prank by a fairy. Furthermore, the EyePri cards for Gumi and Olivia's new outfits also disappear. Inori and the others search for them, but they can't find them, and the time for the live show is fast approaching...
